title: Lie Groups
description: Groups of symmetries that turn smoothly, by any amount. The forces of the Standard Model are three of them: U(1), SU(2) and SU(3). Unlocks the Lie Group Lattice.

puzzle.goal: Write the dimension G of the group SU(n), the number of independent ways it can turn.
puzzle.name: Generators of SU(n)
puzzle.ask: Find d for n = 3 (the strong force: the gluons).
puzzle.method: An n x n unitary matrix has n² real parameters; fixing the determinant at 1 takes one away.
